title: 75 horses for a president. 5 weeks later, he was dead #Shorts
description:
In June 1923, President Warren Harding came to Cedar City, Utah, by train, and sheriffs rounded up about seventy-five horses to ride him up the canyon. He died five weeks later, but the visit had done its work. Zion was famous.

▶ Full documentary (Zion, Part 3: The Impossible Tunnel): https://youtu.be/30zzYRt_Mgk
